classifierProblem: The frozen research incumbent shows label-specific imbalance on short Events: excessive abstention and broad under-production coexist with over-production of a common positive label. Historical loss reweighting and correlated-teacher distillation did not correct this without regression.
hypothesis: Independent semantic Product-18 supervision from three genuinely different language-model agents on rights-admitted short Event text can add missing label semantics without inheriting the incumbent's class priors. Training once on resolved consensus rows, with non-empty and empty outputs balanced, should improve broad short-Event Product-18 behavior without destroying historical COSO behavior.
generalizationRationale: The intervention targets missing semantic supervision across the whole fixed taxonomy on two separately collected short-Event sources. Pool selection and labeling do not use RTN-300, incumbent predictions, COSO errors, desired per-label counts, or label-specific thresholds.

hippocorpus.selection: one row from each of 450 source groups after fixed-seed group shuffle; no labels or model outputs used

unexpectedEvents.selection: one row from each of 450 participant groups after fixed-seed group shuffle; no native labels or model outputs used

sourcePool.validationExclusion: prepared validation groups are excluded and remain unopened until a candidate exists
sourcePool.referenceExclusion: Roadtrip Nation RTN-300 is reference-only and is not used for selection, labeling, training, calibration, or checkpoint selection

blindAgents.independence: Each agent receives only rowId, Event text, the fixed Product-18 definitions, and the 0-2 output contract. It may not read incumbent predictions, COSO/RTN labels, other agent outputs, consensus, source identity, or desired label counts. Each output is frozen before deterministic consensus.

consensusPolicy.high: all three exact label sets match
consensusPolicy.medium: exactly two exact label sets match
consensusPolicy.unresolved: no exact two-of-three set agreement; exclude from training
consensusPolicy.uncertainty: diagnostic only and never overrides exact-set disagreement

feasibilityGate.failure: DO_NOT_TRAIN; do not relax the gate, change consensus, or add an adjudicator

trainingRowsIfFeasible.emptyRows: deterministically sample at most one resolved empty row per resolved non-empty row, source-proportion matched as closely as possible
trainingRowsIfFeasible.labels: resolved exact-set consensus; all absent Product-18 labels are negatives

candidateTrainingIfFeasible.updates: Product-18 classifier head plus top two encoder layers only
candidateTrainingIfFeasible.checkpointSelection: single final checkpoint; no interim COSO or RTN evaluation and no sweep

evaluation.selector: unchanged Product-18 global threshold 0.35, probability-descending fixed-order tie-break, maximum two labels
evaluation.historicalCOSO149: candidate and incumbent under the same canonical evaluator
evaluation.frozenRTN300: one broad candidate-vs-incumbent comparison on frozen HIGH_CONSENSUS and RESOLVED subsets after candidate is final
evaluation.sourceNative: none; model consensus is weak Product-18 supervision, not native or human gold

successCriteria.RTNResolved: micro-F1 improves by at least 0.015 absolute over 0.3163265306; exact-set does not regress; precision does not regress by more than 0.02; recall does not regress; FP <= 64; FN <= 85; summed absolute 0/1/2 count error versus consensus does not exceed incumbent 54
successCriteria.RTNHigh: micro-F1 and exact-set do not regress from 0.3678160920 and 0.5566037736 respectively
successCriteria.COSO149: micro-F1 >= 0.5180528053; macro-F1 >= 0.3351786297; FP <= 60; FN <= 87; no label with support >=5 loses more than 0.08 F1
successCriteria.outputIntegrity: no output outside 0-2 labels and no taxonomy/evaluator/threshold change
successCriteria.decision: RETAIN_FOR_RESEARCH only if every gate passes; otherwise REJECT, or INCONCLUSIVE if evaluation cannot establish direction

promotionStatus: NO_PRODUCTION_PROMOTION regardless of outcome; RTN is model-consensus reference and the incumbent lineage is rights-unresolved
forbidden: use RTN-300 for calibration, threshold, checkpoint, sample, or intervention selection
inspect other agents before own output is frozen
hyperparameter, loss, selector, or threshold sweep
